name: 55455 · Minneapolis, MN
findings: ZIP 55455 (Minneapolis) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 55455 (Minneapolis) has 55 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 95 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Where do people here come together, and who brings them together? Which of those places would not show up in nonprofit records?

observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
